129:t_1:88.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I did realize one thing. ...Miss $$スズネ$$ is trying to protect you. In that case...」

129:t_1:89.en:
$n
「I'll become strong enough to protect Miss $$スズネ$$.」

129:t_1:90.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's right. Do your best, $n.」

129:t_1:91.en:
$n
(I will. But Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't the only one I'll protect...)

129:t_1:92.en:
$n
(I want to become strong enough to protect everyone living in this world...)

129:t_2:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...So $$ゼロ$$ is in $$新日本$$.」

129:t_2:5.en:
$$スザク$$
「Officially, the Federation forces under the supreme command of General $$藤堂$$ are defending $$新日本$$, but former $$黒の騎士団$$ members are helping too.」

129:t_2:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ゼロ$$ serves as their strategist, directing their overall strategy.」

129:t_2:7.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Having conquered Eurasia, the $$新地球皇国$$ appears to be planning to conquer North America and the Pacific Rim.」

129:t_2:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「To seize Japan, the future center of resistance, they probably intend to use $$新日本$$ as a bridgehead.」

129:t_2:9.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Besides $$ゼクス$$ and me, the other $$プリベンター$$ members and our supporters are helping defend $$新日本$$.」

129:t_2:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So $$ヒイロ$$ and the others are there too.」

129:t_2:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「The $$黒の騎士団$$ and $$プリベンター$$ aren't the only ones fighting alongside the Federation forces.」

129:t_2:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$新日本$$ is a nation of resistance. The citizens are united in helping, determined never to let anyone take their country again.」

129:t_2:13.en:
$$スザク$$
「Even so, we're urging noncombatants to evacuate to Japan as a precaution.」

129:t_2:14.en:
$n
「Then we have to drive $$サイデリアル$$ out as soon as possible.」

129:t_2:15.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The battle is evenly matched now, but if we can push them back once, we can reinforce our defenses again.」

129:t_2:16.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So if we force the Empire's troops in $$新日本$$ to retreat, that should settle things for now...」

129:t_2:17.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Once things settle down in $$新日本$$, we can reorganize our forces and prepare Japan's defenses too.」

129:t_2:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So protecting $$新日本$$ means protecting Japan too.」

129:t_2:19.en:
$$カレン$$
「We came to fight the troops heading for Japan, but now we can return to $$新日本$$ with the best possible gift.」

129:t_2:20.en:
$n
「Do you want to see everyone at $$陣代高校$$, $$カレン$$? $$常盤$$ and $$小野Ｄ$$ were shocked when you suddenly transferred out.」

129:t_2:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'd like to see $$恭子$$ and the others, but right now, I'm $$紅月カレン$$ of the $$黒の騎士団$$.」

129:t_2:22.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll do everything I can to protect $$新日本$$... I'll visit $$陣代高校$$ once I've done that.」

129:t_2:23.en:
$n
「I understand. Let me help with that too.」

129:t_2:24.en:
$$カレン$$
「Have you changed a little, $n? You seem more dependable.」

129:t_2:27.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$n has been through a lot too.」

129:t_2:28.en:
$$スザク$$
「But I think it's a good sign. His expression is softer now too.」

129:t_2:29.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$スザク$$... The same goes for you.」

129:t_2:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The same goes for you too, $$ゼクス$$.」

129:t_2:31.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Now that their goals are clear, $$ゼクス$$, $$スザク$$, and $n have probably shaken off their doubts.」

129:t_2:32.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm going to count on you, $n.」

129:t_2:34.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you want to look good in front of Miss $$スズネ$$ that badly...?」

129:t_2:36.en:
$$スザク$$
「It looks like she hit the mark.」

129:t_2:37.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's good that you're trying to stop being the quiet type, but you're too honest.」

129:t_2:38.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I think it's far better than living behind a mask that hides your true feelings.」

129:t_2:40.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「...Captain $$アムロ$$, shall we get going?」

129:t_2:41.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand, $$ゼクス$$. Captain $$オットー$$ has already asked Director $$大塚$$ about our going to $$新日本$$.」

129:t_2:42.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Let's get ready to leave too.」

129:t_2:44.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I know. We were interrupted by $$サイデリアル$$'s attack.」

129:t_2:45.en:
$n
「Yes... I'll set foot in $$第３新東京市$$ myself and promise $$シンジ$$ and the others that we'll win.」

129:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so cruel...! I'm a member of $c too!」

129:t_10:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry, sorry. Anyway... I'm going out with $n and the others now. See you later.」

129:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know, $$カレン$$. You're going to turn your thoughts to $$シンジ$$.」

129:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You were fond of $$シンジ$$ as if he were your little brother...」

129:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those feelings and your resolve to fight generated 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

129:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, from behind the scenes, I'll pray that you and everyone else can be reunited with $$シンジ$$ and the others, $$カレン$$.」

129:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's been a while, $$ゼクス$$ and $$ノイン$$.」

129:t_10:16.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Ah, $$ＡＧ$$... I'll be relying on you again.」

129:t_10:17.en:
$$ノイン$$
「But don't say anything unnecessary. Your wisecracks stress $$ゼクス$$ out.」

129:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. I have no intention of making jokes in a situation as serious as $$新日本$$'s crisis.」

129:t_10:19.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'm sorry, $$ノイン$$. I've made you look out for me again.」

129:t_10:20.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Please don't worry. I do it because I want to.」

129:t_10:21.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even so, let me say it. Thank you, $$ノイン$$.」

129:t_10:23.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Perhaps $n inspired me. I want to move beyond who I was yesterday and always become someone new.」

129:t_10:24.en:
$$ノイン$$
「That's admirable, $$ゼクス$$. That's precisely why I follow you.」

129:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Excuse me! I don't mean to say anything unnecessary, but don't get lost in your own little world in front of my shop!」

129:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Grrr!! That unruffled attitude gets on my nerves!」

129:t_10:30.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Then let me help with your work as an apology.」

129:t_10:32.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Let's get fired up today too... Business, business... ...Is that right?」

129:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-Your handsome, royal, ace-pilot composure is frying my circuits!」

129:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Grrrrrr!! Th-This is the most humiliating commercial in the $$Ｄトレーダー$$'s history!!」
